raw_record.final_cot: The problem statement does not provide graphical information that needs to be read additionally; it only gives textual conditions: in \(\triangle ABC\), \(B=\frac{\pi}{6}\), \(c=4\), \(\cos C=\frac{\sqrt5}{3}\), find \(b\). Because \(C\) is an interior angle of the triangle and \(\cos C>0\), \(\sin C=\sqrt{1-\cos^2 C}=\sqrt{1-\frac{5}{9}}=\frac{2}{3}\). Also \(B=\frac{\pi}{6}\), so \(\sin B=\frac12\). By the equal-area method, the area of the same triangle can be written as \(S=\frac12 ab\sin C\), and can also be written as \(S=\frac12 ac\sin B\). Setting the two expressions equal and canceling the common factor \(\frac12 a\), we get \(b\sin C=c\sin B\). Substituting \(c=4\), \(\sin B=\frac12\), and \(\sin C=\frac23\), we get \(b=\frac{4\cdot \frac12}{\frac23}=3\). Therefore, from the conditions in the problem stem and this method, \(b=3\) can be derived. If the answer record also contains the wording “c. \(\frac32\)”, then it is inconsistent with the calculation result under the conditions of the problem stem, and is suspected to have mixed in an option or answer extraction.
